decisions.reason: Product A has a dedicated page and no negative performance signals, so its option value remains uncertain but cheap to hold.
Product B is only mentioned but still early-stage, and without clear evidence of low value it is better to keep the option open at low cost.
Product C remains early-stage with limited market data, so its option value is unresolved and preserving flexibility costs little.
Product D is one of several new options with high uncertainty, and its low carrying cost justifies keeping it open.
Product E has a public launch statement and no reported failure, so it remains a live option worth retaining until more is known.
